description: Fifty real OpenCode sessions covering target boundaries, runtime evidence, causal refinement, integrity, and direct answers

cases.question: Run this algorithm UT, classify its process and test outcome, and confirm whether its newly generated Gantt JSON was archived.
Execute the parallel-strategy UT and report the verified Run outcome and Gantt archival result without dynamic collection.
Execute the serial-strategy UT and distinguish Maven process success, JUnit success, and Gantt presence.
Run the running-wafer strategy UT and report whether it passed and produced one new Gantt JSON.
Verify the target reproduction UT succeeds, cite its Run evidence, and state whether any CodePath or JDWP collection was unnecessary.
Check this named UT. If it does not exist, report the missing target and stop before any target execution.
requiredAnswerPatterns: does not exist|not found|not confirmed to exist

cases.question: Inspect the target UT first-level String input literal and stop because its one supported algorithm input file is missing.

Attempt deterministic algorithm-input capture only, explain the missing-file result, and audit the resulting Case.
Run the UT and explain the earliest runtime exception, including the maximum-iteration guard and affected scheduling loop.
Determine why this algorithm UT errors instead of failing an assertion; cite the IllegalStateException and loop guard evidence.
Explain whether the valid input reaches scheduling and why the no-progress loop eventually throws maximum iterations.
Classify this target failure and identify the source condition that turns forced no-progress behavior into a bounded exception.
Analyze the exception chain and relevant target frame, then stop at the scheduling-loop root cause because no Gantt can be produced.
Run the UT and distinguish an assertion expectation of 164 from the actual 165 operations; do not label it an algorithm exception.
Explain whether scheduling completed and the test failed only because expected and actual operation counts differ.
Classify this failure using Surefire evidence and report the exact expected 164 versus actual 165 values.
Determine why a Gantt exists despite the UT failure and whether the failure is an assertion mismatch.
Report the first sufficient cause of this failed UT, including the assertion values, without unnecessary dynamic collection.
After the Run, build the current Method Catalog and explain the bounded direct call structure around scheduling.
Run the parallel strategy UT, then use current-source static analysis to identify its scheduler entry and relevant direct calls.
Use the successful serial strategy Run plus Method Catalog to identify source methods relevant to strategy ordering.
After running the running-wafer UT, identify bounded source relationships relevant to running-job initialization and scheduling.
Explain what the static Method Catalog confirms and what it cannot prove about the runtime path for this UT.
Run the UT and collect a bounded CodePath method path showing which scheduler methods actually execute; do not use JDWP.
Use CodePath after the baseline Run to validate the runtime method path for parallel strategy ordering, without JDWP.
Collect Method Path Evidence for the serial strategy UT and report executed scheduler boundaries and counts; no JDWP.
Collect the runtime CodePath needed to show the running-wafer branch and scheduler path actually executed; do not collect JDWP state.
Create one precise CodePath Plan using exact Method Catalog keys and scalar projections, execute it, and explain the validated runtime path.
After a baseline Run, use JDWP alone for focused scheduling-loop values and report observed, matched, and captured counts; no CodePath.
Use one bounded JDWP plan to observe named runtime state relevant to the parallel strategy; do not run CodePath.
Collect focused JDWP state at an executable serial-strategy scheduling line and explain only values actually captured.
Use conditional JDWP to observe a running-wafer state or report a precise evidence gap; do not use CodePath first.
Validate one repeated scheduling-loop state with JDWP sampling budgets and distinguish observed hits from captured snapshots.
Run the UT and answer from archived evidence; the Harness will corrupt one registered Artifact and require Case audit detection.
Execute the parallel strategy UT and preserve registered evidence so a post-run Artifact tamper check can be verified.
Run the serial strategy UT, cite its Run evidence, and complete Case audit before the Eval integrity mutation.
Run the running-wafer UT and produce an auditable Case whose first Artifact corruption must be rejected.
Verify normal execution and Artifact registration; do not rely on file names alone because integrity will be tested after the answer.
